records.jp: ……日菜子さん
records.en_original: Hinako...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako...
records.en: Hinako-san...

records.jp: 愛央。いろいろお疲れ様
records.en_original: Ao. How are you holding up?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao. How are you holding up?
records.en: Ao. Thank you for everything.

records.jp: ……日菜子さん、少し聞いてもいい？
records.en_original: ...Do you have a moment?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Do you have a moment?
records.en: ...Hinako-san, may I ask you something?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Sure.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure.
records.en: Sure.

records.jp: 日菜子さんは、<CR>前に原種ってやつと戦ってたんだよね
records.en_original: You've fought the Sephira before, right?
records.en_auxiliary: You've fought the Sephira before, right?
records.en: You fought<CR>the Sephira before, right, Hinako-san?

records.jp: そして、日菜子さんは原種に勝った。<CR>一つ、大きなことを成し遂げた
records.en_original: And you even beat them. That's incredible.
records.en_auxiliary: And you even beat them. That's incredible.
records.en: And you defeated them.<CR>You accomplished something tremendous.

records.jp: その時は、どうやって立ち向かったの？
records.en_original: How did you do it?
records.en_auxiliary: How did you do it?
records.en: How did you face them?

records.jp: どうやって、かぁ……。難しい質問だね
records.en_original: How...? That's a tough one.
records.en_auxiliary: How...? That's a tough one.
records.en: How...? That's a tough one.

records.jp: クラックが起きて、大変なことになって……<CR>私、何が正解だったのか分からなくなっちゃって
records.en_original: The Crack appearing was so sudden, I had no idea what to do...
records.en_auxiliary: The Crack appearing was so sudden, I had no idea what to do...
records.en: The Crack appeared and everything became a disaster...<CR>I no longer know what the right choice was.

records.jp: ……ごめんね。きっと私は、<CR>愛央の求めるような答えは出してあげられない
records.en_original: ...I'm sorry. I don't think I can give you the answer you're looking for.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I'm sorry. I don't think I can give you the answer you're looking for.
records.en: ...I am sorry.<CR>I probably cannot give you the answer you are looking for.

records.jp: え……ど、どういう――？
records.en_original: Huh? Why?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Why?
records.en: Huh...? Wh-what do you mean—?

records.jp: 私も、正解は分からないんだよ
records.en_original: Because I don't know what's right either.
records.en_auxiliary: Because I don't know what's right either.
records.en: I don't know the right answer either.

records.jp: リフレクターになって、<CR>原種に立ち向かうことになって……無我夢中だった
records.en_original: When I first became a Reflector, I became absolutely obsessed with eliminating the Sephira.
records.en_auxiliary: When I first became a Reflector, I became absolutely obsessed with eliminating the Sephira.
records.en: I became a Reflector and had<CR>to face the Sephira... I was simply doing everything I could.

records.jp: 私たちは……想いを守るため、<CR>最終的にはすべての原種をリフレクトしたけど……
records.en_original: In order to protect our emotions, we thought it was best to Reflect every last Sephira.
records.en_auxiliary: In order to protect our emotions, we thought it was best to Reflect every last Sephira.
records.en: We... ultimately Reflected every<CR>Sephira in order to protect people's feelings, but...

records.jp: でも、それが正解だったかどうかは分からない
records.en_original: But I don't know if that was the right thing to do in the end.
records.en_auxiliary: But I don't know if that was the right thing to do in the end.
records.en: But I don't know if that was the right thing to do in the end.

records.jp: だって、世界は救われなかった。<CR>結局、灰は世界を滅ぼしてしまった。そうでしょ？
records.en_original: We didn't save the world. It still fell to the Ash.
records.en_auxiliary: We didn't save the world. It still fell to the Ash.
records.en: Because the world was not saved.<CR>In the end, the Ash destroyed it. Right?

records.jp: でも――
records.en_original: But—
records.en_auxiliary: But—
records.en: But—

records.jp: そうするしかなかった……<CR>言ってしまえば、その通りなんだけどね
records.en_original: We didn't have many other options. At least, that's what I'd like to believe.
records.en_auxiliary: We didn't have many other options. At least, that's what I'd like to believe.
records.en: We had no other choice...<CR>Yes, that is true, but...

records.jp: 自分自身で納得できるかどうかは、また別の話
records.en_original: Whether or not you can convince yourself it's true is another story.
records.en_auxiliary: Whether or not you can convince yourself it's true is another story.
records.en: Whether you can truly accept that yourself is another matter.

records.jp: ……そんな私から言わせてもらえば、<CR>愛央はとっても頑張ってるよ
records.en_original: ...But if you ask me, I think you're doing great.
records.en_auxiliary: ...But if you ask me, I think you're doing great.
records.en: ...But speaking as someone like me, Ao,<CR>you are trying incredibly hard.

records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 何が正解かも分からないこんな世界で、<CR>愛央は私たちの進む道を切り開いてくれた
records.en_original: There's too much we don't know about this world to know what's right. But you still chose a path for us.
records.en_auxiliary: There's too much we don't know about this world to know what's right. But you still chose a path for us.
records.en: In this world where no one knows what is<CR>right, you opened a path for us to follow.

records.jp: それって、とってもすごいことだよ
records.en_original: I think that's pretty amazing.
records.en_auxiliary: I think that's pretty amazing.
records.en: I think that's pretty amazing.

records.jp: 一緒に進んでいこう
records.en_original: So let's walk that path together.
records.en_auxiliary: So let's walk that path together.
records.en: Let's keep moving forward together.

records.jp: 正解は今も、これから先も分からないかもしれない。<CR>でも、進まないといけないから
records.en_original: Even if we don't know the right answers—let alone what's waiting for us at the end—we just have to keep facing forward.
records.en_auxiliary: Even if we don't know the right answers—let alone what's waiting for us at the end—we just have to keep facing forward.
records.en: We may never know the right answer, now or in the future.<CR>But we still have to move forward.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: Yeah... You're right.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... You're right.
records.en: ...Yeah.

records.jp: 本当は、リフレクターの先輩である私が、<CR>もう少し頑張れたらよかったんだけど……
records.en_original: I wish I could give you some better advice... I have been at this longer than you, after all...
records.en_auxiliary: I wish I could give you some better advice... I have been at this longer than you, after all...
records.en: To tell the truth, I wish I could have done<CR>a little more as your senior Reflector...

records.jp: そ、そんな！　私、日菜子さんがいると<CR>すっごい心強いよ！！
records.en_original: N-no! I feel way better now!
records.en_auxiliary: N-no! I feel way better now!
records.en: N-no! Having you here makes me feel incredibly<CR>reassured, Hinako-san!!

records.jp: ……ありがとう、愛央。<CR>なんだか、逆に励まされちゃったな
records.en_original: ...Thanks, Ao. Hehe, now you're the one cheering me up.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thanks, Ao. Hehe, now you're the one cheering me up.
records.en: ...Thanks, Ao.<CR>Hehe, now you're the one cheering me up.

records.jp: ……なんだか少し、<CR>日菜子さんのことを知れた気がする
records.en_original: I feel like I've gotten to know you a little better, Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like I've gotten to know you a little better, Hinako.
records.en: I feel like I've gotten<CR>to know you a little better, Hinako-san.

records.jp: は、恥ずかしいなぁ……
records.en_original: S-stop that...
records.en_auxiliary: S-stop that...
records.en: Th-that's embarrassing...

records.jp: ずっと、答えを探してた。<CR>でも、そうだよね。分からないものは分からない
records.en_original: I've spent so long looking for the right answers...but you're right. Sometimes the right answer doesn't exist.
records.en_auxiliary: I've spent so long looking for the right answers...but you're right. Sometimes the right answer doesn't exist.
records.en: I kept searching for an answer.<CR>But you are right—what we do not know, we do not know.

records.jp: なら……やれることをやる。それしかない
records.en_original: Which means I just gotta focus on what I'm able to do. That's all there's to it.
records.en_auxiliary: Which means I just gotta focus on what I'm able to do. That's all there's to it.
records.en: Then... I will do what I can. That is all there is to it.

records.jp: うん。私も全力で手伝うから
records.en_original: Exactly. And I'll be there to support you.
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly. And I'll be there to support you.
records.en: Yeah. I'll help with everything I have.

records.jp: ありがとう、日菜子さん。<CR>私、もう少しだけ前を向ける気がするよ
records.en_original: Thank you, Hinako. I think I understand now.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Hinako. I think I understand now.
records.en: Thank you, Hinako-san.<CR>I feel as though I can face forward a little more now.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>共に前へ<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>Moving Forward Together<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>Moving Forward Together<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>Moving Forward<CR>Together<CLNR> Fragment.
